extDescription.message: Resolve a DOI straight from the search box: DOI-only searches go to the DOI resolver instead of a page of search results.

masterSwitchHint.message: Turn the extension off without uninstalling it.

enginesHint.message: Only a query that is entirely a DOI is redirected. Anything else is left alone.

notVerified.description: Badge for engines whose URL shape has not been confirmed

notVerifiedHint.message: The URL shape of these engines has not been confirmed by fetching them, so they are off by default. Enable one if you use it.

customHint.message: Added engines need permission for that one site. Nothing else is requested.

permissionDenied.message: Permission for that site was not granted, so the engine was not added.

invalidEngine.message: Host and search parameter are required.

exceptionsHint.message: Sites listed here are never redirected. A bare host means every page on it.

resolverHint.message: The DOI is appended to this base URL as a path.

patternHint.message: A JavaScript regular expression, tested against the whole decoded search query. This is a matching pattern, not a DOI syntax validator.

testMatch.message: Matches: the search would be redirected.

testNoMatch.message: No match: the search is left alone.

patternInvalid.message: That is not a valid regular expression.

resolverInvalid.message: Must be an http(s) URL with no query string or fragment.
